question: Who among the following was honored with the ‘Global Visionary of Sustainable Business and Peace’ award during the launch of the Federation of Indo-Israel Chamber of Commerce’s international chapter in Dubai on 21 December 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Ratan Tata**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ratan Tata** was honored with the** ‘Global Visionary of Sustainable Business and Peace’ award **during the launch of the** Federation of Indo-Israel Chamber of Commerce’s international chapter in Dubai on 21 December 2020.**
 
• Tata has done** a lot for India-Israel ties.**
 
• He has generously** contributed towards promoting innovation that supports sustainability.**
 
• **He has been a promoter of peace in the region, including with the Palestinians.**
 
• He has visited** Israel a few times which has been extremely beneficial in promoting ties between the two countries.**
